description: This file declares the FrameRate class, which manages FPS collection and reporting functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for starting, stopping, updating FPS data, and handling timers related to FPS reporting.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: A plugin class for managing frame rate collection, reporting, and notifications within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequencyWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set the FPS collection frequency based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: startFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to start FPS collection based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: stopFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to stop FPS collection based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: updateFpsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to update FPS value based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Returns the current FPS collection frequency.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the FPS collection frequency in milliseconds.

methods.name: fpsCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Updates FPS statistics with new data.

methods.name: enableFpsCollection
methods.description: Virtual method to enable FPS collection, can be overridden.

methods.name: disableFpsCollection
methods.description: Virtual method to disable FPS collection, can be overridden.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimer
methods.description: Handles timer event for reporting FPS.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimerTest
methods.description: Test handler for FPS timer event.

methods.description: Constructor for the FrameRate plugin class.
